other_conditions: Applicant must be engaged in building or construction work
Applicant must be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Must have a minimum of two years regular membership with the Board
Must have an active membership with the Board
Family size cannot exceed five members (including the registered worker)
To avail benefits, the worker must pay the registration fee and have at least 90 days of work experience in the preceding year
A Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID) is required for registration
benefits_summary: Free travel to the worker’s home town once a year for up to five family members, with fare paid at the prescribed roadways or railway rate.
